format: UCWDC contests, judge names in raw-score columns

source.quote_free_summary: In the raw-score order each judge's name is included ('so revealed').

requirement: A UCWDC profile must show judge names in the raw-score columns it produces; this contrasts with Studio's hidden-judge default and WSDC's optional anonymity.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: Who sees the raw-score columns (public, contestants, officials) is not stated in this sentence; the DSA paragraph lists some viewers. Not resolved, so no public judge-name display is specified.
decision_refs: OD-23 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A required for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
